runtime.policy: Exact CPython patch versions are declared per operating-system family. Windows uses 3.11.9 because later CPython 3.11 security releases are not provisioned as Windows binaries by the hosted setup catalog; both runtimes execute the same locked ProofGrid dependency set and frozen implementation.

portability_history.finding: Windows reproduction discovered OS-native schema path separators in the RXEP receipt, causing a receipt digest mismatch while the known-answer result and evidence-content digest matched.
portability_history.resolution: Verifier 0.3.1 canonicalized repository-relative schema paths to POSIX form. The calculation method remained 0.3.0.

portability_history.finding: Linux and Windows reproduced the same logical evidence-content and RXEP receipt hashes, but pretty-printed primary artifact files differed byte-for-byte because host-native text writing produced LF on Linux and CRLF on Windows.
portability_history.resolution: Verifier 0.3.2 writes evidence.json, graph.jsonld, receipt.json, and report.html as explicit UTF-8/LF bytes. ProofGrid Genesis run 32438377372 validated the patched core and emitted the frozen byte hashes in this manifest.

independence_scope: Execution occurs on fresh third-party-hosted runner environments from repository-published files only. The reproduction harness is authored in the same repository and therefore is not represented as independent professional or scientific review.
limitations: The Alberta fixture and environmental factors are synthetic software-test data.
Clean-environment reproduction is not professional LCA review, code compliance, engineering approval, regulatory approval, certification, or product-market validation.
A human third-party reproduction remains stronger evidence than repository-authored automation and is still encouraged.
